drift: NONE. HEAD == origin/main == Expected-Base-SHA at preflight; no overlapping source drift and no unowned dirty source file.
unblockedBoundary: Fulfillment had no concept of an accepted shipping group, so a paid seller order with two accepted groups could not be executed as two shipments and nothing prevented a shipment from mixing lines of different groups.

migration.name: 20261016120000_AddFulfillmentShippingGroups
ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment.shipping_groups (PK shipping_group_id; UNIQUE (fulfillment_id, shipping_group_id); INDEX fulfillment_id)
ALTER TABLE fulfillment.items ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS shipping_group_id uuid NULL (+ partial index)
ALTER TABLE fulfillment.shipments ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS shipping_group_id uuid NULL (+ partial index)
migration.note: Additive and idempotent DDL. No database was touched; runtime behaviour of the migration is UNPROVEN.

contractsAdded: OrderFulfillmentShippingGroupSnapshot(ShippingGroupId, SellerOrderId, SellerPartyId, MethodCode, ServiceCode, OptionCode, MethodLabel, OriginContext, MinimumDeliveryDate, RequestedDeliveryDate, RequestedDeliveryTimeWindow, LeadDays, OrderLineIds)
crossModuleHandoff: Order -> Fulfillment via Tooba.Order.Contracts.Fulfillment only. OrderFulfillmentBridge loads order.order_shipping_groups/order_shipping_group_lines for the requested SellerOrder and projects OrderFulfillmentShippingGroupSnapshot. Fulfillment never opens an Order DbContext and Order never opens a Fulfillment DbContext.
groupExecutionInvariant: One FulfillmentUnit per SellerOrder (unchanged). Inside a unit, each accepted group has a stable identity and every order line belongs to exactly one group; a shipment may only carry lines of a single group and must name that group when the order is grouped. Groups of different sellers can never merge.
legacyCompatibility: Orders with no persisted groups keep ShippingGroups = null on the handoff, items and shipments keep shipping_group_id = NULL, and the single-method creation path is unchanged. Older shipment/group rows stay readable.
noSideEffectsOnOpen: Opening shipping or the payment draft creates no shipment and no group row; groups are persisted only while creating a fulfillment for a paid order, shipments only through explicit seller mutation.

tests.reruns: targeted reruns only after concrete fixes (test assertions, .Length -> .Count)
tests.notExecuted: No EF/runtime DB validation, no browser acceptance, no shared environment.
